verification_method: Fresh reviewer in an isolated context, given only assembled stems, lead-ins, options, keyed answers and rationales, with no access to the construction record, the discipline profiles, the gate output or the evidence packets.
answer_key_agreement: The reviewer reached the keyed answer independently on 7 of 7 items and disagreed with no key.

defects.detail: Option D, awaiting the second high-sensitivity troponin, has no anchor in a stem that supplies an unambiguously diagnostic ST-elevation tracing, so it is not a live choice and the effective option set is three.

items.failure_reason: Option D is non-competitive; the item effectively offers three functioning options.

defects.detail: Option C, restarting supplemental oxygen, is foreclosed by a stem that states she has held room-air saturations of 93 to 95 percent for a day with settled work of breathing, so no partially knowledgeable candidate has a reason to select it.

items.failure_reason: Option C is non-competitive; the stem explicitly forecloses any oxygen requirement, leaving three functioning options.

overall_comment: Both failures are the same mode and it is one no rule in the current design covers: an option carrying no positive anchor in the stem. It is distinct from exclusion by explicit stem negation, which asks whether a stem clause was planted to kill a competitor, and from response-class membership, which asks whether an option belongs to the demanded class. A biomarker wait is a next action for current care and a restart of oxygen is a supportive-care action, so both survive ADM-1; neither is a lone category, so both survive ADM-2; neither is defeated by a planted negation, so both survive ADM-3; neither restates an enacted practice, so both survive ADM-4; and neither breaks format parity, so both survive ADM-5.
